verdict.rationale: Plausible is built as privacy-first, cookie-less analytics with no personal data or user identification (plausible-docs-23, plausible-docs-29), and community evidence notes the founders explicitly refuse to track user flows for privacy reasons (plausible-comm-5). There is no evidence of any account/company-level grouping, user identification, or B2B entity-based reporting anywhere in the pack — only site-level aggregate metrics, funnels, and goals.
